Anatomy of an app

What’s beneath the screen.

An app is much more than a screen: it’s five layers working together. We build every one of them, from your first idea to ongoing care.

01Screen

02AI

03Features

04Data

05Server

  • App StoreApp Store
  • Google PlayGoogle Play
  • WebWeb

  1. 01 / 04

    Your idea.

    From the outside, an app is a single thing: an icon on a phone, an address on the web. It all starts with what you want to offer your members, your students or your customers.

  2. 02 / 04

    The five layers.

    1. 01

      Screen iPhone · Android · Web

      What your members see and touch, on a phone or a computer.

    2. 02

      AI Assistants · automation

      AI wherever it saves you time: drafting, sorting, answering.

    3. 03

      Features API · business logic

      Your rules, turned into actions: posting an announcement, receiving a request.

    4. 04

      Data PostgreSQL · backups

      Your information, neatly organized and protected, with encrypted backups.

    5. 05

      Server OVHcloud · Docker

      Our own server, hosted in Beauharnois, Québec.

  3. 03 / 04

    The launch.

    When everything is ready, the layers come back together as a single app. We publish it where your users will find it.

    • App Store
    • Google Play
    • Web

  4. 04 / 04

    Ongoing care.

    An app lives on after its launch. We maintain it and keep improving it with you.

    • Security updates
    • Bug fixes
    • Encrypted backups
    • Improvements based on your feedback

We build every layer — and we stay with you.

Your data

Follow your data.

We host your apps on our own server in Beauharnois, Québec. Here’s the path your information takes, from your members’ phones all the way to the backup.

Our commitments

  • Hosted in Québec

    Your apps run on our own server, at OVHcloud in Beauharnois. You know where your data is.

    OVHcloud · Beauharnois

  • Encrypted backups

    Your data is copied regularly, and those copies are encrypted: unreadable to anyone without the key.

    PostgreSQL · encrypted copies

  • HTTPS everywhere

    Every exchange between your users and the server is encrypted. Browsers are even instructed to use only the secure version.

    HTTPS · HSTS

  • Québec’s Law 25: your data stays yours

    We collect only what is strictly necessary, and we never sell it. A named person is in charge of protecting it: John Maibwe.

    Privacy policy (in French) →

And on this website: no advertising cookies and no visitor analytics.

Our approach

Every project follows the same path: start from how you actually work, deliver a reliable tool, then improve it with you.

  2. Design

Tell us about your project

Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions we hear most often — in plain language.

Another question? Write to us →
How much does a website or an app cost?

Every project is unique: the price depends on the number of pages or screens, the features and your needs. We offer a free assessment and a clear quote before any commitment — no surprises along the way.

How long will my project take?

A business website usually takes a few weeks. A mobile app or custom software takes longer, depending on the scope of the project: we give you a realistic timeline from the start.

Do you offer artificial intelligence solutions?

Yes. We bring in artificial intelligence where it delivers real value: assistants, document sorting and drafting, search across your information, task automation. We explain clearly what the AI does with your data before anything is put in place.

Do you handle hosting and the domain name?

Yes. We take care of the domain name, hosting on our own server in Québec, business email and going live. You have nothing technical to manage: that’s our job.

Can my website or app evolve after launch?

Absolutely — that’s our whole philosophy. We keep improving your tools based on your feedback, and we also take over projects built by others to fix or extend them.

Do you work with organizations outside Québec?

Yes. Applications John Maibwe is based in Québec and also serves DR Congo and francophone Africa: meetings take place remotely, and follow-up happens online.

About

From Québec to DR Congo.

Applications John Maibwe (AJM) is a sole proprietorship founded in Québec in May 2026 by John Maibwe. One point of contact, from the first conversation all the way to maintenance: you always know who you’re talking to.

We don’t just build nice websites. Parishes, schools, non-profits, small businesses, entrepreneurs: we speak your language, not just the language of technology. Every project starts with one simple question: what would truly save you time?

  • Small businesses here and abroad
  • Entrepreneurs and new ventures

What guides us
